loop.top3_why: The series is strongly trend‑dominated with moderate ranking stability (Kendall tau 0.548). The mean over pool2 (A) yields a more consistent error profile (0.02, –0.07, 0.11) and a gap of only 0.0168 to the leader, which is within the noise tolerance. Thus A balances stability and performance and is likely to generalize better to the blind test window.
loop.top3_why_not: Candidate B, while having the best mean score, shows extreme per‑window variability and relies on a single model that may not be robust to unseen data. Candidate C has a higher mean score and similar per‑window pattern to A but uses a larger pool, which can introduce more noise without clear benefit. Therefore B and C are less preferable to A.
